label: Axiom MCP (app-owned OAuth)
message: Axiom supports browser OAuth with explicit public client registration. Sign in and choose your organization at Axiom; no native login is reused. openid and offline_access support sign-in and renewal, not read-only provider permissions. The host credential may carry your account's write access, but this broker exposes only separately approved bounded reads. Query results route through US infrastructure; queries can incur cost. Set role query-cost limits in Axiom if needed.
